description: Manufacturer specification sheets from the source collection, merged and translated to English. These are copied manufacturer data, not campaign measurements.

dji_flip.flight_time: Up to 20 minutes (flying at 40 km/h with no wind)
dji_flip.dimensions_with_propellers: 255 x 312 x 127 mm (L x W x H)
dji_flip.dimensions_without_propellers: 178 x 232 x 127 mm (L x W x H)

dji_neo.note: This sheet was stored in the Neo 2 session folders on the source share. The figures describe DJI Neo (about 135 g), not Neo 2. Do not treat them as Neo 2 specifications.
dji_neo.flight_time: Up to 18 minutes (17 min with propeller guards)
dji_neo.max_speed: 57.6 km/h (16 m/s in Manual mode), 28.8 km/h (Normal mode)
dji_neo.dimensions_with_guards: 130 x 157 x 48.5 mm (L x W x H)
dji_neo.transmission_range: Up to 10 km (FCC with controller), 50 m (phone Wi-Fi)

dji_mini_4_pro.flight_time: Up to 34 minutes (standard battery); up to 45 minutes (Plus battery)
dji_mini_4_pro.dimensions_folded_without_propellers: 148 x 94 x 64 mm (L x W x H)
dji_mini_4_pro.dimensions_unfolded_with_propellers: 298 x 373 x 101 mm (L x W x H)

dji_matrice_350_rtk.obstacle_sensing: Six-direction binocular vision system and radar
